content.comment_body: Hello, I previously used a program created in [product_name] [version_no], which was downloaded to [product_name] [version_no] (not [article_no]). The TIA configuration was then transferred to the [product_name] hardware with [article_no], and everything worked fine. Now, I have a [product_name] [version_no], but I'm unable to establish a connection. Is it possible to monitor bits in [product_name] Runtime Advanced? Thanks! [user_name]

This issue has already been discussed in the German section of the forum, where it was noted that [company_name] is aware of the problem. Specifically, see the fifth reply in the relevant thread by [user_name]: 'LOGO 8 FS4 & WinCC RT - keine Verbindung'.

analysis.insight_summary: There is a reported connectivity issue between the new [product_name] [version_no] hardware and [product_name] Runtime Advanced. Earlier versions and setups functioned without problem, but migrating to the [version_no] hardware has led to connection failures. Forum feedback indicates this is a known issue that [company_name] is aware of.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate that the updated [product_name] [version_no] hardware should work with previous configurations and support seamless monitoring in [product_name] Runtime Advanced, similar to older hardware versions.
